landing.headline: Accurate Body Measurements from Two Camera Angles
landing.description: Contactless body measurement extraction from orthogonal front and side photographs. Generates a three-dimensional mannequin, recommends ideal garment sizing, and guarantees privacy.
landing.step1Desc: Stand before the camera with a standard ID-1 card or A4 paper to establish millimeter-per-pixel scale calibration.
landing.step2Desc: Assume an A-pose at a frontal zero-degree angle, then turn ninety degrees sideways following on-screen cues.
landing.step3Desc: Instantly view seven anatomical measurements, an interactive 3D mannequin, and tailored brand recommendations.
landing.privacyDesc: Image processing executes exclusively in your browser volatile memory. Once geometric extraction finishes, raw frames are destroyed and never stored anywhere.
landing.privacyPoint1: No image storage on remote servers or persistent databases.
landing.privacyPoint2: Only anonymous numeric dimensional data is preserved.
landing.studioDesc: Connect seamlessly with clients via secure access tokens, establish proprietary size specifications, and configure style-based ease allowances.

features.title: Engineering rigor behind every measurement
features.sub: Combining computational geometry with clinical anthropometrics for millimeter-accurate garment fit.

p1.title: Dual-Perspective Biometric Scan
p1.desc: Anatomical landmark detection paired with Ramanujan ellipse calculus computes true cross-sectional circumference from just one front and one profile photo.

p2.title: Real-Time Humanoid Topology
p2.desc: Direct bone morphing and ZOZOFIT dual-layer wireframe render an accurate anatomical representation of your torso, waist, and hips in real time.

p3.title: Zero-Retention Ephemeral Privacy
p3.desc: Scan frames are processed entirely in ephemeral RAM and immediately discarded. No camera footage or biometric photos ever touch disk storage.

p4.title: Bespoke Tailor Specification Dossiers
p4.desc: Instantly generate encrypted client measurement dossiers accessible via expiring token and export complete sizing breakdowns to PDF.

how.title: Four-stage biometric pipeline

tech.subtitle: The Science of Perfect Fit
tech.title: Why Is FitVision 3D Far More Accurate Than Generic Size Charts?
tech.f1Desc: No crude heuristics. We cross-section chest, waist, and hip planar curves with Ramanujan elliptical integrals and Siri-Deurenberg biological tissue density to extract true dimensions.
tech.f2Desc: Captured customer photos are processed entirely in-memory RAM and permanently purged immediately (Zero-Retention Policy). No sensitive imagery is ever stored on disk or servers.
tech.f3Desc: Garments should never cling like a second skin. FitVision 3D precisely factors ease allowance (+3cm to +6cm) to ensure you look sharp while staying comfortable throughout the day.
